normal.name: hiisikoloART
normal.text: I finished Plaque Tale, and I liked it more than the first probably because it was less buggy (and I had less broken controller). Tho some of the bugs forced me to restart the game, and the massive linearity makes it so if you miss a thing, you really miss it. Also, the combat is fine when there is a big area, but the small area fights were burning my bacon. Solid 7 and 1/2 out of 10. #game #videogame #PlaqueTale #opinion
